title: Bugs/Bug 647818 Source Currency Amount FCY GL Entries Reversal Charged
summary: Fixes how the source currency amount is handled when general ledger entries in a foreign currency are reversed. The fix is a one-line change in the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit, repeated in 11 localization layers.
key_points: Corrected source currency amount calculation for FCY GL entries reversal
Applied fix consistently across 11 localization layers (W1, NA, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NO, RU)
Single-line change in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit in each layer
Addresses bug in financial posting process for multi-currency transactions
